description: Expected squared-error Bayes risk for nonnegative class evidence, with an annealed KL divergence from the uniform Dirichlet after removing target-class evidence.

examples.title: Train a classifier with evidential loss

name: Evidential expected squared-error loss

parameters.annealing_coef: finite scalar in [0, 1] multiplying the target-evidence-masked Dirichlet KL penalty (default 1.0)
parameters.ignore_index: must be None; ignored labels are not defined for this loss
parameters.logits_or_prediction: nonnegative floating point evidence tensor with shape [B, K]; activation is supplied by the model
parameters.reduction: none per sample, mean over the batch, or sum (default mean)
parameters.targets: integer class indices with shape [B] and values in [0, K)
